2nd Floor 3BR/1BA Full Flat
* $6,195/month annual lease
* Approximately 1,600 sq. ft.
* Foyer
* Formal dining room
* Ornamental fireplace
* Washer and dryer in kitchen
* Private deck
* Shared yard and terrace
* Small pet considered
* Parking available for an add'l fee
* Available: November 1st or sooner
OPEN HOUSE: Sunday (10/4) 3:00pm-3:30pm
ADDRESS: 33 Loyola Terrace
Second floor 3BR/1BA full flat in NOPA, next to UCSF. Floors are hardwood except in bath. Heat is forced air and windows are double-pane. Flat is entered via a sizeable foyer. Living room is at the front of the flat, facing the street. Foyer also connects to the formal dining room, which provides access to the galley-style kitchen at the back of the flat. Dining room has two built-in cabinets. The kitchen is large, includes granite counters, gas stove with hood, dishwasher, and has two sinks and lots of cabinets. Stacked washer and dryer are in a closet in the kitchen. Kitchen opens onto the private deck which in turn provides access to the shared yard. Half the yard has artificial grass; the other half is landscaped terraces. Owner pays for yard maintenance. Two large bedrooms are on one side of the flat; third, smaller bedroom is at the back of the flat, facing the yard. Large bedrooms have standard closets. Bath has shower-over-tub.
Building is in a well-maintained, two-unit Edwardian on a small cul-de-sac at 33 Loyola Terrace. Walls are insulated. Tenant pays for utilities and garbage. Parking is available in the building for an additional fee. Neighborhood has many shopping and dining opportunities and Haight Street is just six blocks away. Golden Gate Park is four blocks distant. Walk Score is 94, Transit Score is 73. Bus lines 5, 21 and 43 are from half a block to five blocks away.
Tenant pays a one-time broker's fee.

2nd Floor 2-3BR/1BA Apartment

* Pet friendly

* Available: November 10th or sooner
OPEN HOUSE: Sunday (10/4) 4pm-4:30pm
ADDRESS: 2011 Sacramento Street #1
Spacious second floor 2-3BR/1BA apartment in Pacific Heights, located directly across from Lafayette Park. Floors are hard­wood except in bath; heat is steam; lights are inset. The flexible layout can accommodate three bedrooms without a separate living room, or two bedrooms with a living room. The mid-unit living room connects to the kitchen and central hallway and features a wall closet with sliding mirrored doors, allowing it to function comfortably as a third bedroom.
Kitchen is at the front of the apartment. Its all stainless appliances include gas stove, microwave and dishwasher. Bedrooms are side-by-side at the rear of the apartment. Both have bay windows. One has a walk-in closet, the other has a wall closet with sliding mirror doors. Beautiful marble bath has shower-over-tub with sliding glass doors. Combo washer/dryer is located in the central hallway in a closet and is next to a walk-in hall closet.
Elegant building is on Sacramento at Gough. Polk Street's extensive shopping and dining district is three blocks away, and it's just 4.5 blocks to Fillmore Street shopping and dining. Walk Score is 94, Transit Score is 85. Van Ness Avenue is three blocks away and bus lines 1, 19, 27 and 49 are all within three blocks.
